text:
incident-bot: INCIDENT PAGE: high error rate observed for /v1/generate — spike in 429 and 503 across eu-west and us-central. Paging @alice.sre and @ben.oncall. Incident INC-20260317-42. Runbook: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/inc-429-503

alice.sre: ack, joining. I can see the spike on the global error-rate dashboard. Is it tenant-localized or broad?

ben.oncall: i'm on it. quick numbers from the ingress: 429 rate jumped from ~0.2% to 8.7% over last 10m for /v1/generate. 503s also up but smaller. Top tenants by 429: tenant-a, tenant-d, tenant-g.

ben.oncall: (datadog query)
```
sum:ingress.http.requests{route:/v1/generate,status:429}.as_count() by {tenant}.rollup(sum, 300)
```

carla-runtime: thanks. looking at runtime metrics — backend pool showing elevated queue_time and KV cache evictions. I'm going to apply a short-term gateway-level per-tenant throttle (50 req/s) to blunt the burst while we root-cause. Will apply now.

incident-bot: Runbook reminder: notify customers with >1% error rate and start mitigation path. Escalate to eng-ml if errors persist >15m.

dan-support: drafting customer notify for the top 5 tenants. paste for review:
```
Hi — we observed elevated errors on the generation endpoint and have applied temporary rate-limiting to reduce impact while we investigate. We're monitoring and will follow up with timeline and mitigation steps.
```

eve-cs: hold on blasting until we have ETA/mitigation note. Customer X reported embeddings-only failures — can we confirm whether it's route-specific?

frank-sre: correlating traces now — embeddings traffic hits a different backend pool and shows increased 503s tied to cold-starts on a subset of pods. Also seeing a KV cache miss spike that lines up with 503 bursts.

alice.sre: can someone toggle non-critical features that may increase tail pressure? suggest disabling `auto-telemetry` and throttling background prefetch for 20m. Command to flip: `feature-toggle toggle auto-telemetry off --env prod`

carla-runtime: done — `auto-telemetry` disabled. also bumped runtime cache size on pool-2 and initiated rolling restart of 3 nodes to reclaim memory. Immediate metrics: p95 latency down ~150ms, 429 trending down in eu-west.

ben.oncall: snapshot from dashboards (last 5m): 429 rate at 3.2% (was 8.7), 503s reduced by ~60%. Holding gateway cap at 50r/s per-tenant for 30m and watching.

alice.sre: plan: keep per-tenant cap, keep auto-telemetry off, collect failed request samples and eval prompts for model team, and if errors spike back above 1% for any top tenant we'll route those requests to a smaller model variant as fallback. Please log the tenant list in the incident doc.

dan-support: :thumbsup: customer notice queued, will send once we have the 15m checkin numbers. One customer asked for SLA note, prepping that paragraph.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied (gateway caps + feature freeze + cache bump). Monitoring 429/503 trends and will post next update in 10m or earlier if status changes. This thread will be the incident channel.
